comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Live Batch proof job 4e807453 stayed RUNNABLE for the full poll (~5 minutes) with no attempts and no CloudWatch logs. Compute environment GpuComputeEnv-103T34rYMA14WnAp is VALID/ENABLED; the ASG desired capacity stayed 0.

Root cause: AuritusGpuJobDef asks for 4 vCPU, 15360 MiB, and 1 GPU. The only instance type is g4dn.xlarge (4 vCPU, 16 GiB). AWS Batch will not place a 4-vCPU job on a 4-vCPU instance because the ECS agent and AMI need leftover CPU/memory, so the scheduler never scales.

Next: change the job definition to 2 vCPU and 8192 MiB, set allocationStrategy BEST_FIT_PROGRESSIVE, deploy CDK, then submit a new proof job. The existing RUNNABLE job cannot be reused because its container overrides already bake in 4 vCPU.
